selection.basis: Display axes requested after study completion; values do not affect inclusion. This is not a preregistration.
selection.excluded: Other scenarios/targets/phases, individual control cells, and all paired-comparison tables remain in the full aggregate.

definitions.replicate: One trained seed. Actor/request/tick counts are exposure, not independent training repeats.
definitions.statistics: Unweighted mean and sample SD across seeds; undefined values remain None with explicit n_undefined.
definitions.selection: Native/state/observation comparisons require identical recorded heldout count, class support and per-actor/request exposure; frozen probe source uses the same scored-row selector.
definitions.slices: Phase marginals and all-phase public-payload-token marginals are separate. Their joint intersections are not in the frozen source output and are not fabricated here.
definitions.native: Existing conditional eight-FINISH argmax, with payload/version derived from that choice. Repeated native scores across feature views are not independent evidence.
definitions.meaning: Independent supervised readout accessibility is not autonomous task control, information-theoretic retention, or a pure encoding/decay attribution.
definitions.selected_view: Exactly the listed 540 summary cells / 1620 seed rows. This file does not contain all full-aggregate cells.
definitions.control_ranges: Global ranges use every full-aggregate domain and feature, separately for overall cells and all recorded marginals. The latter includes small/empty phase populations and is not a chance-level encoding test.
definitions.seed_csv: Per-seed n, class support, accuracy, balanced accuracy, native counts/scores, exposures, and exclusions for selected cells. Source-record indices refer to the matching seed/arm input listed above.
definitions.completeness: The complete frozen 15-source audit is preserved, not re-run on raw probe data. Packaging additionally verifies full table hashes, selection completeness, and per-seed agreement.
